newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Philippine says 1996 gold output up.
newsitem.headline: Philippine says 1996 gold output up.

text.p: Gold output in 1996 from the Philippines' commercial mines rose to 16,927 kg from the year-ago 12,396 kg, a government official said on Tuesday.
The value of the 1996 gold production from the big mines was put at 5.625 billion pesos, up from 3.971 billion pesos in 1995, Horacio Ramos, Director, Mines and Geosciences Bureau, said.
Ramos said gold panned by small-scale miners from January to June in 1996 increased to 7,910 kg worth 2.608 billion pesos. The comparative year-ago figure was not available.
For the whole of 1995, small miners produced 14,493 kg of gold worth 4.471 billion pesos, he said.
